en: Define and identify leases
Conduct initial measurement for leases from the perspective of lessee and lessor
Conduct subsequent measurement for leases from the perspective of lessee and lessor
Identify the circumstances for derecognition of leases and the accounting treatment
Discuss the disclosure requirements for lease variations
Analyze, critically evaluate and interpret issues in accounting for leases
ms: Takrif dan kenal pasti pajakan
Lakukan pengukuran awal pajakan dari perspektif lessee dan lessor
Lakukan pengukuran selepas pengiktirafan pajakan dari perspektif lessee dan lessor
Kenal pasti keadaan nyahpengiktirafan pajakan dan layanan perakaunan
Bincangkan keperluan pendedahan variasi pajakan
Analisis, nilai secara kritikal dan tafsir isu perakaunan pajakan

en: From **1 January 2019**, **MFRS 16 Leases** applies. It equals **IFRS 16** and **replaces MFRS 117** (used since 2012).
It covers recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure of leases for the **lessor** and the **lessee**.
**Main change:** a **single lessee accounting model**. The lessee recognises almost all leases on the balance sheet as a **right-of-use (ROU) asset** and a **lease liability**.
**Lessor accounting is largely unchanged**: the lessor still classifies each lease as a **finance lease** or an **operating lease**.
ms: Mulai **1 Januari 2019**, **MFRS 16 Leases** terpakai. Ia sama dengan **IFRS 16** dan **menggantikan MFRS 117** (digunakan sejak 2012).
Ia meliputi pengiktirafan, pengukuran, pembentangan dan pendedahan pajakan untuk **lessor** dan **lessee**.
**Perubahan utama:** **satu model perakaunan lessee**. Lessee mengiktiraf hampir semua pajakan dalam kunci kira-kira sebagai **aset hak guna (ROU)** dan **liabiliti pajakan**.
**Perakaunan lessor hampir tidak berubah**: lessor masih mengelaskan setiap pajakan sebagai **pajakan kewangan** atau **pajakan operasi**.

blocks.en: Memory hook: LESSOR = owner who lets out the asset. LESSEE = user who rents it. Under MFRS 16 the big change is on the LESSEE side.
blocks.ms: Cara ingat: LESSOR = pemilik yang memajakkan aset. LESSEE = pengguna yang menyewa. Di bawah MFRS 16 perubahan besar di pihak LESSEE.

en: Party
Advantages
ms: Pihak
Kelebihan

en: Lessor
Periodic receipts give interest revenue; retains ownership of the asset; boosts sales
ms: Lessor
Penerimaan berkala beri hasil faedah; mengekalkan pemilikan aset; meningkatkan jualan

en: Lessee
Flexibility in using assets; less costly financing
ms: Lessee
Fleksibiliti menggunakan aset; pembiayaan kurang mahal

en: **Information technology:** quickly adapt to technology changes.
**Transportation:** huge financial commitments; leasing is a good financing option.
**Construction and agriculture:** reduces the chance of assets sitting idle in some periods.
ms: **Teknologi maklumat:** cepat menyesuaikan diri dengan perubahan teknologi.
**Pengangkutan:** komitmen kewangan besar; pajakan ialah pilihan pembiayaan yang baik.
**Pembinaan dan pertanian:** mengurangkan kemungkinan aset terbiar pada tempoh tertentu.

blocks.en: A contract is (or contains) a **lease** if it conveys the **right to control the use of an identified asset** for a period of time in exchange for consideration.
blocks.ms: Satu kontrak ialah (atau mengandungi) **pajakan** jika ia memberi **hak mengawal penggunaan aset yang dikenal pasti** untuk suatu tempoh sebagai balasan.

en: There is an **identified asset** (and the supplier has no substantive right to substitute it).
The customer obtains **substantially all the economic benefits** from using the asset.
The customer **directs how and for what purpose** the asset is used.
ms: Ada **aset dikenal pasti** (dan pembekal tiada hak penggantian yang substantif).
Pelanggan memperoleh **hampir semua manfaat ekonomi** daripada penggunaan aset.
Pelanggan **mengarahkan bagaimana dan untuk tujuan apa** aset digunakan.

blocks.en: This is how you tell a **lease contract** from a **service contract** (e.g. a supplier that can swap the asset freely is providing a service, not a lease).
blocks.ms: Inilah cara membezakan **kontrak pajakan** daripada **kontrak perkhidmatan** (cth pembekal yang boleh menukar aset sesuka hati memberi perkhidmatan, bukan pajakan).

blocks.en: There is **no finance/operating split for the lessee**. At the **commencement date** the lessee recognises:
blocks.ms: **Tiada pembahagian kewangan/operasi untuk lessee**. Pada **tarikh permulaan** lessee mengiktiraf:

en: A **right-of-use (ROU) asset**.
A **lease liability**.
ms: Satu **aset hak guna (ROU)**.
Satu **liabiliti pajakan**.

blocks.en: Initial measurement
blocks.ms: Pengukuran awal

en: **Lease liability** = **present value of lease payments not yet paid**, discounted at the **rate implicit in the lease**, or the lessee's **incremental borrowing rate** if the implicit rate cannot be readily determined.
**ROU asset (cost)** = initial lease liability + lease payments made at or before commencement − lease incentives received + initial direct costs + estimated costs of dismantling/restoring the asset.
ms: **Liabiliti pajakan** = **nilai kini bayaran pajakan yang belum dibayar**, didiskaun pada **kadar tersirat dalam pajakan**, atau **kadar pinjaman tambahan** lessee jika kadar tersirat tidak mudah ditentukan.
**Aset ROU (kos)** = liabiliti pajakan awal + bayaran pajakan pada atau sebelum permulaan − insentif pajakan diterima + kos langsung awal + anggaran kos membuka/memulihkan aset.

blocks.en: Lease payments included in the liability
blocks.ms: Bayaran pajakan dalam liabiliti

en: Fixed payments (less lease incentives).
Variable payments that depend on an **index or rate**.
Amounts expected to be paid under **residual value guarantees**.
The **exercise price of a purchase option** if reasonably certain to be exercised.
**Termination penalties** if the lease term reflects the lessee exercising a termination option.
ms: Bayaran tetap (tolak insentif pajakan).
Bayaran berubah yang bergantung pada **indeks atau kadar**.
Amaun dijangka dibayar di bawah **jaminan nilai sisa**.
**Harga laksana opsyen belian** jika hampir pasti dilaksanakan.
**Penalti penamatan** jika tempoh pajakan mencerminkan lessee melaksanakan opsyen penamatan.

blocks.en: Subsequent measurement
blocks.ms: Pengukuran selepas pengiktirafan

en: **ROU asset:** cost less accumulated **depreciation** and **impairment** (MFRS 136). Depreciate from commencement to the **earlier of** the end of the useful life or the end of the lease term (use the useful life if ownership transfers or a purchase option is reasonably certain).
**Lease liability:** increased by **interest** (effective interest method), reduced by **payments**; remeasured when the lease is reassessed or modified.
**P/L:** depreciation and interest expense are shown **separately** (not a single rent expense).
ms: **Aset ROU:** kos tolak **susut nilai** dan **rosot nilai** terkumpul (MFRS 136). Susut nilai dari permulaan hingga **yang lebih awal** antara akhir hayat berguna atau akhir tempoh pajakan (guna hayat berguna jika pemilikan berpindah atau opsyen belian hampir pasti).
**Liabiliti pajakan:** ditambah **faedah** (kaedah faedah efektif), dikurangkan **bayaran**; diukur semula bila pajakan dinilai semula atau diubah suai.
**P/L:** susut nilai dan belanja faedah ditunjuk **berasingan** (bukan satu belanja sewa).

blocks.en: Optional exemptions (expense straight-line)
blocks.ms: Pengecualian pilihan (belanja garis lurus)

en: **Short-term leases:** lease term of **12 months or less** with no purchase option.
**Low-value assets:** underlying asset is of low value when new (e.g. tablets, small office equipment).
ms: **Pajakan jangka pendek:** tempoh pajakan **12 bulan atau kurang** tanpa opsyen belian.
**Aset bernilai rendah:** aset asas bernilai rendah apabila baharu (cth tablet, peralatan pejabat kecil).

blocks.en: The textbook slides still describe the lessee under the old MFRS 117 split (finance lease vs operating lease). That split no longer applies to the lessee under MFRS 16, so this chapter follows MFRS 16.
blocks.ms: Slide buku teks masih menerangkan lessee mengikut pembahagian lama MFRS 117 (pajakan kewangan vs operasi). Pembahagian itu tidak lagi terpakai kepada lessee di bawah MFRS 16, jadi bab ini mengikut MFRS 16.

title.en: Worked Example: ROU Asset & Lease Liability
title.ms: Contoh Kerja: Aset ROU & Liabiliti Pajakan

blocks.en: Numbers are invented for practice.
blocks.ms: Nombor direka untuk latihan.

blocks.en: A lessee signs a 3-year lease starting 1 January 20x1. Annual payment RM10,000 at each year-end. Interest rate implicit in the lease 8%. Straight-line depreciation over the lease term, no residual value, no other costs.
blocks.ms: Lessee tandatangan pajakan 3 tahun bermula 1 Januari 20x1. Bayaran tahunan RM10,000 pada setiap hujung tahun. Kadar faedah tersirat 8%. Susut nilai garis lurus sepanjang tempoh pajakan, tiada nilai sisa, tiada kos lain.

en: Year
Opening liability
Interest 8%
Payment
Closing liability
ms: Tahun
Liabiliti awal
Faedah 8%
Bayaran
Liabiliti akhir

blocks.en: Year-3 interest (740) is the balancing figure so the liability ends at zero (rounding). Total interest = 3 × 10,000 − 25,771 = 4,229 (= 2,062 + 1,427 + 740). Year-1 P/L = interest 2,062 + depreciation 8,590 = 10,652, higher than the 10,000 rent of the old operating-lease treatment (front-loaded expense).
blocks.ms: Faedah tahun 3 (740) ialah angka pelaras supaya liabiliti berakhir sifar (pembundaran). Jumlah faedah = 3 × 10,000 − 25,771 = 4,229 (= 2,062 + 1,427 + 740). P/L tahun 1 = faedah 2,062 + susut nilai 8,590 = 10,652, lebih tinggi daripada sewa 10,000 layanan pajakan operasi lama (belanja dimuka).

blocks.en: If the lessee also prepaid RM2,000 at commencement, paid initial direct costs of RM1,000 and received a RM500 incentive: ROU asset = 25,771 + 2,000 + 1,000 − 500 = RM28,271 (the liability stays RM25,771).
blocks.ms: Jika lessee juga bayar dahulu RM2,000 pada permulaan, bayar kos langsung awal RM1,000 dan terima insentif RM500: aset ROU = 25,771 + 2,000 + 1,000 − 500 = RM28,271 (liabiliti kekal RM25,771).

blocks.en: The **lessor** classifies each lease at **inception**. The classification depends on **substance**, not legal form.
blocks.ms: **Lessor** mengelaskan setiap pajakan pada **permulaan**. Pengelasan bergantung pada **substansi**, bukan bentuk undang-undang.

en: Finance lease
Operating lease
ms: Pajakan kewangan
Pajakan operasi

en: Definition
Transfers **substantially all risks and rewards** incidental to ownership of the underlying asset (title may or may not transfer)
A lease **other than a finance lease**: risks and rewards are **not** transferred
ms: Takrif
Memindahkan **hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran** pemilikan aset asas (hak milik mungkin atau tidak berpindah)
Pajakan **selain pajakan kewangan**: risiko dan ganjaran **tidak** dipindahkan

en: Owner
Lessee has the economic benefits; lessor holds legal title
Lessor is **legal AND beneficial owner**
ms: Pemilik
Lessee mendapat manfaat ekonomi; lessor pegang hak milik sah
Lessor ialah **pemilik sah DAN benefisial**

en: Ownership transfers to the lessee by the end of the lease term.
The lessee has a **purchase option** reasonably certain to be exercised.
The lease term is for the **major part of the economic life** of the asset.
The **PV of lease payments** amounts to **substantially all of the fair value** of the asset.
The asset is **so specialised** that only the lessee can use it without major modification.
ms: Pemilikan berpindah kepada lessee menjelang akhir tempoh pajakan.
Lessee ada **opsyen belian** yang hampir pasti dilaksanakan.
Tempoh pajakan meliputi **sebahagian besar hayat ekonomi** aset.
**PV bayaran pajakan** mencapai **hampir keseluruhan nilai saksama** aset.
Aset **begitu khusus** hingga hanya lessee boleh guna tanpa ubah suai besar.

blocks.en: These are examples/indicators: use judgement (substance over form). Class exercise: Example 7.1.
blocks.ms: Ini contoh/petunjuk: guna pertimbangan (substansi mengatasi bentuk). Latihan kelas: Contoh 7.1.

blocks.en: Finance lease
blocks.ms: Pajakan kewangan

en: At **commencement**, **derecognise** the underlying asset and recognise a **lease receivable** equal to the **net investment in the lease** (PV of lease payments plus unguaranteed residual value, at the rate implicit in the lease).
**Subsequently:** each receipt is **principal receipt + finance income**; finance income reflects a **constant periodic rate** of return on the net investment.
ms: Pada **permulaan**, **nyahiktiraf** aset asas dan iktiraf **belum terima pajakan** sama dengan **pelaburan bersih dalam pajakan** (PV bayaran pajakan tambah nilai sisa tidak dijamin, pada kadar tersirat).
**Selepas itu:** setiap penerimaan ialah **penerimaan prinsipal + pendapatan kewangan**; pendapatan kewangan mencerminkan **kadar pulangan berkala tetap** atas pelaburan bersih.

blocks.en: Operating lease
blocks.ms: Pajakan operasi

en: Lessor **keeps the asset** on its books and **depreciates** it according to its nature.
Recognise **lease income on a straight-line basis** over the lease term (or another systematic basis).
**Costs of earning the income** (e.g. depreciation, initial direct costs) are expensed.
ms: Lessor **mengekalkan aset** dalam rekod dan **menyusutnilainya** mengikut sifatnya.
Iktiraf **pendapatan pajakan secara garis lurus** sepanjang tempoh pajakan (atau asas sistematik lain).
**Kos memperoleh pendapatan** (cth susut nilai, kos langsung awal) dibelanjakan.

en: Finance lease (lessor)
Operating lease (lessor)
ms: Pajakan kewangan (lessor)
Pajakan operasi (lessor)

en: Leased asset
Derecognised; lease receivable recognised
Stays on lessor's books
ms: Aset pajakan
Dinyahiktiraf; belum terima pajakan diiktiraf
Kekal dalam rekod lessor

en: Income
Finance income (effective interest)
Rental income (straight-line)
ms: Pendapatan
Pendapatan kewangan (faedah efektif)
Pendapatan sewa (garis lurus)

en: Depreciation
None (asset gone)
Yes, by lessor
ms: Susut nilai
Tiada (aset sudah keluar)
Ya, oleh lessor

blocks.en: Mirror image: the lessor's finance-lease receivable for the 3-year example is also RM25,771, with finance income of 2,062 in year 1.
blocks.ms: Imej cermin: belum terima pajakan lessor untuk contoh 3 tahun juga RM25,771, dengan pendapatan kewangan 2,062 pada tahun 1.

blocks.en: Lessee
blocks.ms: Lessee

en: Present **ROU assets** separately in the statement of financial position (or within PPE with disclosure of which line item); present **lease liabilities** separately (current/non-current).
**Depreciation** of ROU assets by class and **interest expense** on lease liabilities.
Expense for **short-term** and **low-value** leases; **variable lease payments** not in the liability.
**Total cash outflow** for leases; **additions** to ROU assets; **carrying amount** of ROU assets by class.
A **maturity analysis** of lease liabilities (MFRS 7).
A **general description** of leasing arrangements: basis of variable payments, renewal/purchase options, restrictions.
ms: Bentang **aset ROU** berasingan dalam penyata kedudukan kewangan (atau dalam PPE dengan pendedahan baris item); bentang **liabiliti pajakan** berasingan (semasa/bukan semasa).
**Susut nilai** aset ROU mengikut kelas dan **belanja faedah** atas liabiliti pajakan.
Belanja untuk pajakan **jangka pendek** dan **bernilai rendah**; **bayaran pajakan berubah** tidak dalam liabiliti.
**Jumlah aliran tunai keluar** untuk pajakan; **tambahan** aset ROU; **amaun dibawa** aset ROU mengikut kelas.
**Analisis kematangan** liabiliti pajakan (MFRS 7).
**Penerangan am** pengaturan pajakan: asas bayaran berubah, opsyen pembaharuan/pembelian, sekatan.

blocks.en: Lessor
blocks.ms: Lessor

en: Finance leases: **selling profit/loss**, **finance income** on the net investment, and a **maturity analysis** of lease payments receivable.
Operating leases: **lease income** and a **maturity analysis** of payments to be received; assets subject to operating leases are presented by class.
ms: Pajakan kewangan: **untung/rugi jualan**, **pendapatan kewangan** atas pelaburan bersih, dan **analisis kematangan** bayaran pajakan belum terima.
Pajakan operasi: **pendapatan pajakan** dan **analisis kematangan** bayaran akan diterima; aset di bawah pajakan operasi dibentang mengikut kelas.

blocks.en: The slides list the older MFRS 117 disclosures (minimum lease payments, non-cancellable operating leases). Use the MFRS 16 list above. Class exercises: Examples 7.4 and 7.5.
blocks.ms: Slide menyenaraikan pendedahan MFRS 117 lama (bayaran pajakan minimum, pajakan operasi tidak boleh dibatalkan). Guna senarai MFRS 16 di atas. Latihan kelas: Contoh 7.4 dan 7.5.

en: **Lessee:** accounts for the lease under the single model (a lease of land and building gives ROU assets/lease liability; lease components may be separated or, as a practical expedient, combined).
**Lessor:** assesses **land and building separately** for finance/operating classification.
**Land** (indefinite economic life) is normally an **operating lease** unless title is expected to pass to the lessee.
If the **land element is immaterial**, the lessor may treat land and building as **one unit** and use the building's economic life.
ms: **Lessee:** mengakaun pajakan di bawah model tunggal (pajakan tanah dan bangunan memberi aset ROU/liabiliti pajakan; komponen pajakan boleh diasingkan atau, sebagai kemudahan praktikal, digabung).
**Lessor:** menilai **tanah dan bangunan secara berasingan** untuk pengelasan kewangan/operasi.
**Tanah** (hayat ekonomi tidak terhad) biasanya **pajakan operasi** kecuali hak milik dijangka berpindah kepada lessee.
Jika **elemen tanah tidak material**, lessor boleh layan tanah dan bangunan sebagai **satu unit** dan guna hayat ekonomi bangunan.

blocks.en: A manufacturer or dealer lessor that grants a **finance lease** recognises **selling profit** at commencement, plus finance income over the term:
blocks.ms: Lessor pengilang atau peniaga yang memberi **pajakan kewangan** mengiktiraf **untung jualan** pada permulaan, serta pendapatan kewangan sepanjang tempoh:

en: Item
Amount
ms: Item
Amaun

en: Revenue (sale price)
Lower of fair value and PV of lease payments (at a market rate)
ms: Hasil (harga jualan)
Lebih rendah antara nilai saksama dan PV bayaran pajakan (pada kadar pasaran)

en: Cost of sales
Cost (carrying amount) − PV of unguaranteed residual value
ms: Kos jualan
Kos (amaun dibawa) − PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin

en: Selling profit/loss
Revenue − cost of sales
ms: Untung/rugi jualan
Hasil − kos jualan

en: Lease receivable
Net investment = PV of lease payments + PV of unguaranteed residual
ms: Belum terima pajakan
Pelaburan bersih = PV bayaran pajakan + PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): fair value RM100,000; PV of lease payments RM95,000; asset cost RM80,000; PV of unguaranteed residual value RM5,000.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): nilai saksama RM100,000; PV bayaran pajakan RM95,000; kos aset RM80,000; PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin RM5,000.

blocks.en: Revenue = lower of 100,000 and 95,000 = 95,000. Cost of sales = 80,000 − 5,000 = 75,000. Selling profit = 20,000. Net investment (receivable) = 95,000 + 5,000 = 100,000.
blocks.ms: Hasil = lebih rendah antara 100,000 dan 95,000 = 95,000. Kos jualan = 80,000 − 5,000 = 75,000. Untung jualan = 20,000. Pelaburan bersih (belum terima) = 95,000 + 5,000 = 100,000.

blocks.en: The seller-lessee first asks: **does the transfer satisfy MFRS 15 as a sale?**
blocks.ms: Penjual-lessee mula-mula bertanya: **adakah pemindahan memenuhi MFRS 15 sebagai jualan?**

en: Transfer IS a sale
Transfer is NOT a sale
ms: Pemindahan ADALAH jualan
Pemindahan BUKAN jualan

en: Seller-lessee

Derecognise the asset. Recognise an **ROU asset** = proportion of the asset's previous carrying amount that relates to the right of use retained. Recognise the **lease liability**. Recognise **gain/loss only on the rights transferred**.
Keep the asset. Recognise a **financial liability** equal to the proceeds.
ms: Penjual-lessee

Nyahiktiraf aset. Iktiraf **aset ROU** = kadar amaun dibawa terdahulu yang berkaitan dengan hak guna yang dikekalkan. Iktiraf **liabiliti pajakan**. Iktiraf **untung/rugi hanya atas hak yang dipindahkan**.
Kekalkan aset. Iktiraf **liabiliti kewangan** sama dengan hasil.

en: Buyer-lessor
Account for the purchase under the applicable standard, and the lease using lessor accounting (finance/operating).
Recognise a **financial asset** equal to the amount paid.
ms: Pembeli-lessor
Akaun pembelian di bawah piawaian berkenaan, dan pajakan menggunakan perakaunan lessor (kewangan/operasi).
Iktiraf **aset kewangan** sama dengan amaun dibayar.

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): an asset with carrying amount RM800,000 and fair value RM1,000,000 is sold for RM1,000,000 (a sale under MFRS 15) and leased back for 5 years; the PV of the lease payments is RM300,000.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): aset amaun dibawa RM800,000 dan nilai saksama RM1,000,000 dijual RM1,000,000 (jualan di bawah MFRS 15) dan dipajak balik 5 tahun; PV bayaran pajakan RM300,000.

blocks.en: Check: Dr 1,240,000 = Cr 1,240,000. The remaining 60,000 of gain (200,000 − 140,000) is not recognised because it relates to the right of use the seller keeps.
blocks.ms: Semak: Dr 1,240,000 = Cr 1,240,000. Baki untung 60,000 (200,000 − 140,000) tidak diiktiraf kerana ia berkaitan hak guna yang penjual kekalkan.

blocks.en: If the sale price is not at fair value, adjust for the difference (below market = prepaid lease payment; above market = additional financing).
blocks.ms: Jika harga jualan bukan pada nilai saksama, laraskan perbezaan (di bawah pasaran = bayaran pajakan terdahulu; di atas pasaran = pembiayaan tambahan).

blocks.en: Substance over form
blocks.ms: Substansi mengatasi bentuk

blocks.en: Lease accounting applies **substance over form**: what matters is who has the **risks and rewards** and **control of use**, not who holds legal title.
blocks.ms: Perakaunan pajakan guna **substansi mengatasi bentuk**: yang penting ialah siapa ada **risiko dan ganjaran** dan **kawalan penggunaan**, bukan siapa pegang hak milik sah.

blocks.en: Why MFRS 16 / IFRS 16
blocks.ms: Kenapa MFRS 16 / IFRS 16

en: Addresses **off-balance-sheet financing**: under the old rules operating leases kept debt off the balance sheet, so gearing looked lower than reality.
**Single lessee model** based on the **right-of-use** approach.
Effect: the lessee recognises **all leases** except **short-term** and **low-value** leases.
Need to distinguish a **lease contract from a service contract**.
The right-of-use model also applies to **subleases**.
**Sale and leaseback:** the sale must meet the requirements of the revenue standard (MFRS 15).
ms: Menangani **pembiayaan luar kunci kira-kira**: di bawah peraturan lama pajakan operasi mengekalkan hutang di luar kunci kira-kira, jadi nisbah hutang nampak lebih rendah daripada realiti.
**Model lessee tunggal** berasaskan pendekatan **hak guna**.
Kesan: lessee mengiktiraf **semua pajakan** kecuali pajakan **jangka pendek** dan **bernilai rendah**.
Perlu membezakan **kontrak pajakan daripada kontrak perkhidmatan**.
Model hak guna terpakai juga untuk **sub-pajakan**.
**Jual dan pajak balik:** jualan mesti memenuhi keperluan piawaian hasil (MFRS 15).

blocks.en: Typical exam effect: a lessee's assets and liabilities both rise, gearing worsens, EBITDA rises (rent becomes depreciation + interest), and early-year profit falls.
blocks.ms: Kesan biasa dalam exam: aset dan liabiliti lessee kedua-duanya naik, nisbah hutang memburuk, EBITDA naik (sewa jadi susut nilai + faedah), dan untung tahun awal turun.

q.en: When did MFRS 16 start and what did it replace?
q.ms: Bila MFRS 16 bermula dan apa digantikan?

a.en: 1 January 2019; replaces MFRS 117 Leases (equivalent to IFRS 16).
a.ms: 1 Januari 2019; menggantikan MFRS 117 Leases (sama dengan IFRS 16).

q.en: Main change under MFRS 16
q.ms: Perubahan utama MFRS 16

a.en: A single lessee model: recognise an ROU asset and a lease liability for almost all leases. Lessor accounting is largely unchanged.
a.ms: Satu model lessee: iktiraf aset ROU dan liabiliti pajakan untuk hampir semua pajakan. Perakaunan lessor hampir tidak berubah.

q.en: Advantages of leasing: lessee
q.ms: Kelebihan pajakan: lessee

a.en: Flexibility in using assets; less costly financing.
a.ms: Fleksibiliti menggunakan aset; pembiayaan kurang mahal.

q.en: Advantages of leasing: lessor
q.ms: Kelebihan pajakan: lessor

a.en: Interest revenue from periodic receipts; retains ownership; boosts sales.
a.ms: Hasil faedah daripada penerimaan berkala; kekal pemilik; tingkatkan jualan.

q.en: When is a contract a lease?
q.ms: Bila kontrak ialah pajakan?

a.en: When it conveys the right to control the use of an identified asset for a period in exchange for consideration.
a.ms: Bila ia memberi hak mengawal penggunaan aset dikenal pasti untuk suatu tempoh sebagai balasan.

q.en: Lease vs service contract
q.ms: Pajakan vs kontrak perkhidmatan

a.en: Lease: identified asset, customer gets substantially all benefits and directs its use. If the supplier can freely substitute the asset, it is a service.
a.ms: Pajakan: aset dikenal pasti, pelanggan dapat hampir semua manfaat dan mengarah penggunaannya. Jika pembekal boleh menggantikan aset bebas, ia perkhidmatan.

q.en: Does the lessee classify leases as finance/operating (MFRS 16)?
q.ms: Adakah lessee mengelas pajakan kewangan/operasi (MFRS 16)?

a.en: No. A single model applies to the lessee.
a.ms: Tidak. Satu model terpakai kepada lessee.

q.en: Lessee initial recognition
q.ms: Pengiktirafan awal lessee

a.en: At commencement: ROU asset and lease liability.
a.ms: Pada permulaan: aset ROU dan liabiliti pajakan.

q.en: How is the lease liability measured initially?
q.ms: Bagaimana liabiliti pajakan diukur awal?

a.en: PV of lease payments not yet paid, discounted at the implicit rate (or incremental borrowing rate).
a.ms: PV bayaran pajakan belum dibayar, didiskaun pada kadar tersirat (atau kadar pinjaman tambahan).

q.en: Cost of the ROU asset
q.ms: Kos aset ROU

a.en: Initial lease liability + payments at/before commencement − incentives + initial direct costs + restoration costs.
a.ms: Liabiliti pajakan awal + bayaran pada/sebelum permulaan − insentif + kos langsung awal + kos pemulihan.

q.en: Subsequent: ROU asset vs lease liability
q.ms: Selepas pengiktirafan: aset ROU vs liabiliti pajakan

a.en: ROU: cost − depreciation − impairment. Liability: + interest (effective rate) − payments.
a.ms: ROU: kos − susut nilai − rosot nilai. Liabiliti: + faedah (kadar efektif) − bayaran.

q.en: Lessee exemptions
q.ms: Pengecualian lessee

a.en: Short-term leases (12 months or less) and low-value assets: expense straight-line.
a.ms: Pajakan jangka pendek (12 bulan atau kurang) dan aset bernilai rendah: belanja garis lurus.

q.en: Over what period is the ROU asset depreciated?
q.ms: Susut nilai aset ROU dalam tempoh apa?

a.en: Commencement to the earlier of end of useful life and end of lease term (useful life if ownership transfers/purchase option reasonably certain).
a.ms: Dari permulaan hingga yang lebih awal antara akhir hayat berguna dan akhir tempoh pajakan (hayat berguna jika pemilikan berpindah/opsyen belian hampir pasti).

q.en: Initial lessee journal
q.ms: Jurnal awal lessee

a.en: Dr Right-of-use asset; Cr Lease liability.
a.ms: Dr Aset hak guna; Cr Liabiliti pajakan.

q.en: Instalment journal
q.ms: Jurnal ansuran

a.en: Dr Interest expense; Dr Lease liability (principal); Cr Bank.
a.ms: Dr Belanja faedah; Dr Liabiliti pajakan (prinsipal); Cr Bank.

q.en: Interest on a lease liability
q.ms: Faedah atas liabiliti pajakan

a.en: Opening liability × interest rate (e.g. 25,771 × 8% = 2,062).
a.ms: Liabiliti awal × kadar faedah (cth 25,771 × 8% = 2,062).

q.en: Lessor: finance lease definition
q.ms: Lessor: takrif pajakan kewangan

a.en: Transfers substantially all risks and rewards incidental to ownership of the underlying asset.
a.ms: Memindahkan hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran pemilikan aset asas.

q.en: Lessor: operating lease definition
q.ms: Lessor: takrif pajakan operasi

a.en: Any lease that is not a finance lease; lessor is legal and beneficial owner.
a.ms: Mana-mana pajakan bukan pajakan kewangan; lessor pemilik sah dan benefisial.

q.en: Indicators of a finance lease
q.ms: Petunjuk pajakan kewangan

a.en: Ownership transfers; purchase option reasonably certain; major part of economic life; PV ≈ substantially all FV; specialised asset.
a.ms: Pemilikan berpindah; opsyen belian hampir pasti; sebahagian besar hayat ekonomi; PV ≈ hampir semua FV; aset khusus.

q.en: Lessor finance lease: initial
q.ms: Pajakan kewangan lessor: awal

a.en: Derecognise the asset; recognise lease receivable = net investment in the lease.
a.ms: Nyahiktiraf aset; iktiraf belum terima pajakan = pelaburan bersih dalam pajakan.

q.en: Lessor finance lease: receipts
q.ms: Pajakan kewangan lessor: penerimaan

a.en: Each receipt = principal receipt + finance income (constant periodic rate).
a.ms: Setiap penerimaan = penerimaan prinsipal + pendapatan kewangan (kadar berkala tetap).

q.en: Lessor operating lease
q.ms: Pajakan operasi lessor

a.en: Keep and depreciate the asset; recognise lease income straight-line.
a.ms: Kekalkan dan susutnilaikan aset; iktiraf pendapatan pajakan garis lurus.

q.en: Lessee P/L presentation
q.ms: Pembentangan P/L lessee

a.en: Depreciation of ROU asset and interest expense shown separately (not one rent expense).
a.ms: Susut nilai aset ROU dan belanja faedah ditunjuk berasingan (bukan satu belanja sewa).

q.en: Maturity analysis
q.ms: Analisis kematangan

a.en: Lessees disclose a maturity analysis of lease liabilities; lessors disclose one for lease payments receivable.
a.ms: Lessee dedah analisis kematangan liabiliti pajakan; lessor dedah untuk bayaran pajakan belum terima.

q.en: Land and building: lessor classification
q.ms: Tanah dan bangunan: pengelasan lessor

a.en: Assess land and building separately; land normally operating unless title passes; if land is immaterial treat as one unit.
a.ms: Nilai tanah dan bangunan berasingan; tanah biasanya operasi kecuali hak milik berpindah; jika tanah tidak material layan sebagai satu unit.

q.en: Dealer lessor: revenue and cost of sales
q.ms: Lessor peniaga: hasil dan kos jualan

a.en: Revenue = lower of FV and PV of lease payments; cost of sales = cost − PV of unguaranteed residual.
a.ms: Hasil = lebih rendah antara FV dan PV bayaran pajakan; kos jualan = kos − PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin.

q.en: Sale and leaseback: first question
q.ms: Jual dan pajak balik: soalan pertama

a.en: Does the transfer meet MFRS 15 as a sale? If not, the seller-lessee keeps the asset and records a financial liability.
a.ms: Adakah pemindahan memenuhi MFRS 15 sebagai jualan? Jika tidak, penjual-lessee kekalkan aset dan rekod liabiliti kewangan.

q.en: Sale and leaseback (sale): gain recognised
q.ms: Jual dan pajak balik (jualan): untung diiktiraf

a.en: Only the gain relating to the rights transferred; ROU asset = share of carrying amount retained.
a.ms: Hanya untung berkaitan hak dipindahkan; aset ROU = bahagian amaun dibawa yang dikekalkan.

q.en: Why was IFRS 16 introduced?
q.ms: Kenapa IFRS 16 diperkenalkan?

a.en: To bring leases on balance sheet and end off-balance-sheet financing through a single right-of-use lessee model.
a.ms: Untuk bawa pajakan ke kunci kira-kira dan hentikan pembiayaan luar kunci kira-kira melalui model lessee hak guna tunggal.

q.en: Effect of MFRS 16 on a lessee's ratios
q.ms: Kesan MFRS 16 pada nisbah lessee

a.en: Assets and liabilities rise, gearing worsens, EBITDA rises, early-year profit falls.
a.ms: Aset dan liabiliti naik, nisbah hutang memburuk, EBITDA naik, untung tahun awal turun.

q.en: MFRS 16 Leases became applicable on:
q.ms: MFRS 16 Leases mula terpakai pada:

e.en: MFRS 16 applies from 1 January 2019, replacing MFRS 117.
e.ms: MFRS 16 terpakai dari 1 Januari 2019, menggantikan MFRS 117.

q.en: The main change MFRS 16 introduced is:
q.ms: Perubahan utama yang diperkenalkan MFRS 16:

e.en: Single lessee model; lessor accounting is largely unchanged.
e.ms: Model lessee tunggal; perakaunan lessor hampir tidak berubah.

q.en: Which is an advantage of leasing to the lessee?
q.ms: Yang manakah kelebihan pajakan kepada lessee?

e.en: Lessee: flexibility and less costly financing.
e.ms: Lessee: fleksibiliti dan pembiayaan kurang mahal.

q.en: A contract is a lease if it conveys:
q.ms: Kontrak ialah pajakan jika ia memberi:

o: A right to sell the asset to others
A promise to deliver services using any available asset
The right to control the use of an identified asset for a period in exchange for consideration

e.en: Right to control use of an identified asset for a period of time.
e.ms: Hak mengawal penggunaan aset dikenal pasti untuk suatu tempoh.

q.en: A supplier can freely substitute the asset at any time. The contract is most likely:
q.ms: Pembekal boleh menggantikan aset bila-bila masa dengan bebas. Kontrak itu kemungkinan besar:

e.en: No identified asset → service contract.
e.ms: Tiada aset dikenal pasti → kontrak perkhidmatan.

q.en: Under MFRS 16, a lessee classifies each lease as finance or operating.
q.ms: Di bawah MFRS 16, lessee mengelaskan setiap pajakan sebagai kewangan atau operasi.

o: False: a single model applies to the lessee
True, but only for leases over 5 years

e.en: The finance/operating split now matters mainly to the lessor.
e.ms: Pembahagian kewangan/operasi kini penting terutama kepada lessor.

q.en: At the commencement date a lessee recognises:
q.ms: Pada tarikh permulaan lessee mengiktiraf:

o: An ROU asset and a lease liability

e.en: ROU asset and lease liability.
e.ms: Aset ROU dan liabiliti pajakan.

q.en: The lease liability is initially measured at:
q.ms: Liabiliti pajakan diukur awal pada:

o: PV of lease payments not yet paid

e.en: PV of the unpaid lease payments.
e.ms: PV bayaran pajakan belum dibayar.

q.en: Which is a short-term lease exemption?
q.ms: Yang manakah pengecualian pajakan jangka pendek?

o: Lease term of 12 months or less with no purchase option
Lease of less than RM1 million

e.en: 12 months or less and no purchase option.
e.ms: 12 bulan atau kurang dan tiada opsyen belian.

q.en: A lessee leases a tablet computer (low-value asset) for 3 years. It may:
q.ms: Lessee memajak komputer tablet (aset bernilai rendah) 3 tahun. Ia boleh:

o: Treat it as a finance lease only

e.en: Low-value asset exemption allows straight-line expense.
e.ms: Pengecualian aset bernilai rendah membenarkan belanja garis lurus.

q.en: Under MFRS 16 a lessee's P/L shows:
q.ms: Di bawah MFRS 16 P/L lessee menunjukkan:

o: Depreciation of the ROU asset and interest on the lease liability

e.en: Two separate expenses: depreciation and interest.
e.ms: Dua belanja berasingan: susut nilai dan faedah.

q.en: A 3-year lease has annual payments of RM10,000 at year-end and an implicit rate of 8% (annuity factor 2.5771). The initial lease liability is:
q.ms: Pajakan 3 tahun bayaran tahunan RM10,000 pada hujung tahun, kadar tersirat 8% (faktor anuiti 2.5771). Liabiliti pajakan awal:

q.en: First-year interest on that liability (RM25,771 at 8%) is:
q.ms: Faedah tahun pertama liabiliti itu (RM25,771 pada 8%):

q.en: Same lease. The year-1 payment of RM10,000 reduces the liability by:
q.ms: Pajakan sama. Bayaran tahun 1 RM10,000 mengurangkan liabiliti sebanyak:

q.en: Same lease: annual straight-line depreciation of the ROU asset is:
q.ms: Pajakan sama: susut nilai garis lurus tahunan aset ROU:

q.en: Lease liability RM25,771; prepaid at commencement RM2,000; initial direct costs RM1,000; incentive received RM500. The ROU asset is:
q.ms: Liabiliti pajakan RM25,771; dibayar dahulu RM2,000; kos langsung awal RM1,000; insentif diterima RM500. Aset ROU:

q.en: A lessor classifies a lease as a finance lease when it:
q.ms: Lessor mengelaskan pajakan sebagai pajakan kewangan bila ia:

o: Transfers substantially all risks and rewards of ownership
Is for more than one year

e.en: Substance: risks and rewards of ownership transfer.
e.ms: Substansi: risiko dan ganjaran pemilikan berpindah.

q.en: Which is an indicator of a finance lease?
q.ms: Yang manakah petunjuk pajakan kewangan?

o: Lease term is a small part of the asset's economic life
Ownership transfers to the lessee at the end of the lease
PV of payments is a small part of fair value

e.en: Ownership transfer at lease end is a classic indicator.
e.ms: Pemindahan pemilikan pada akhir pajakan ialah petunjuk klasik.

q.en: In a finance lease the lessor recognises at commencement:
q.ms: Dalam pajakan kewangan lessor mengiktiraf pada permulaan:

o: A lease receivable equal to the net investment in the lease

e.en: Lease receivable = net investment; asset derecognised.
e.ms: Belum terima pajakan = pelaburan bersih; aset dinyahiktiraf.

q.en: Each receipt in a lessor's finance lease includes:
q.ms: Setiap penerimaan dalam pajakan kewangan lessor termasuk:

e.en: Principal receipt + finance income.
e.ms: Penerimaan prinsipal + pendapatan kewangan.

q.en: In an operating lease the lessor:
q.ms: Dalam pajakan operasi lessor:

o: Continues to depreciate the asset and recognises income straight-line

e.en: Asset stays; depreciation expensed; income straight-line.
e.ms: Aset kekal; susut nilai dibelanjakan; pendapatan garis lurus.

q.en: Which disclosure is required for lease liabilities?
q.ms: Pendedahan mana diperlukan untuk liabiliti pajakan?

e.en: A maturity analysis of lease liabilities is disclosed.
e.ms: Analisis kematangan liabiliti pajakan didedahkan.

q.en: For a lease of land, the lessor normally classifies the land as:
q.ms: Bagi pajakan tanah, lessor biasanya mengelaskan tanah sebagai:

o: An operating lease unless title is expected to pass

e.en: Land has an indefinite life; operating unless title passes.
e.ms: Tanah hayat tidak terhad; operasi kecuali hak milik berpindah.

q.en: A dealer lessor: fair value RM100,000; PV of lease payments RM95,000. The revenue recognised is:
q.ms: Lessor peniaga: nilai saksama RM100,000; PV bayaran pajakan RM95,000. Hasil diiktiraf:

e.en: Lower of FV and PV of lease payments.
e.ms: Lebih rendah antara FV dan PV bayaran pajakan.

q.en: Same dealer: cost RM80,000; PV of unguaranteed residual RM5,000. Selling profit is:
q.ms: Peniaga sama: kos RM80,000; PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin RM5,000. Untung jualan:

q.en: In a sale and leaseback, the first assessment is whether the transfer:
q.ms: Dalam jual dan pajak balik, penilaian pertama ialah sama ada pemindahan:

e.en: If not a sale, the seller keeps the asset and records a financial liability.
e.ms: Jika bukan jualan, penjual kekalkan aset dan rekod liabiliti kewangan.

q.en: Asset carrying amount RM800,000; FV and sale price RM1,000,000; PV of leaseback payments RM300,000. The ROU asset recognised is:
q.ms: Amaun dibawa aset RM800,000; FV dan harga jualan RM1,000,000; PV bayaran pajak balik RM300,000. Aset ROU diiktiraf:

q.en: Same facts. The gain recognised on the rights transferred is:
q.ms: Fakta sama. Untung diiktiraf atas hak dipindahkan:

q.en: Lease classification by substance is an example of:
q.ms: Pengelasan pajakan ikut substansi ialah contoh:

e.en: Risks, rewards and control, not legal title.
e.ms: Risiko, ganjaran dan kawalan, bukan hak milik sah.

q.en: Which is a typical effect of MFRS 16 on a lessee's financial statements?
q.ms: Yang manakah kesan lazim MFRS 16 pada penyata kewangan lessee?

e.en: ROU asset and lease liability are added; gearing worsens.
e.ms: Aset ROU dan liabiliti pajakan ditambah; nisbah hutang memburuk.

q.en: Distinguish between a finance lease and an operating lease for the lessor, and explain why classification relies on substance over form.
q.ms: Bezakan pajakan kewangan dan pajakan operasi bagi lessor, dan terangkan kenapa pengelasan bergantung pada substansi mengatasi bentuk.

en: Finance lease: transfers substantially all risks and rewards of ownership (1)
Title may or may not transfer (1)
Operating lease: any other lease; risks and rewards stay with the lessor (1)
Lessor is legal and beneficial owner in an operating lease (1)
Indicators: ownership transfer, purchase option, major part of life, PV ≈ FV, specialised asset (1)
Substance over form: economic reality over legal title (1)
ms: Pajakan kewangan: memindahkan hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran pemilikan (1)
Hak milik mungkin atau tidak berpindah (1)
Pajakan operasi: pajakan lain; risiko dan ganjaran kekal dengan lessor (1)
Lessor pemilik sah dan benefisial dalam pajakan operasi (1)
Petunjuk: pemindahan pemilikan, opsyen belian, sebahagian besar hayat, PV ≈ FV, aset khusus (1)
Substansi mengatasi bentuk: realiti ekonomi mengatasi hak milik sah (1)

q.en: A lessee signs a 3-year lease with annual payments of RM20,000 at each year-end. The implicit rate is 10% (PV of the three payments is RM49,737). Under MFRS 16, show the initial journal, the year-1 payment journal and year-1 depreciation (straight-line, no residual).
q.ms: Lessee tandatangan pajakan 3 tahun dengan bayaran tahunan RM20,000 pada setiap hujung tahun. Kadar tersirat 10% (PV tiga bayaran ialah RM49,737). Di bawah MFRS 16, tunjukkan jurnal awal, jurnal bayaran tahun 1 dan susut nilai tahun 1 (garis lurus, tiada nilai sisa).

en: Dr Right-of-use asset 49,737; Cr Lease liability 49,737 (2)
Dr Interest expense 4,974; Dr Lease liability 15,026; Cr Bank 20,000 (2)
Dr Depreciation expense 16,579; Cr Accumulated depreciation 16,579 (1)
ms: Dr Aset hak guna 49,737; Cr Liabiliti pajakan 49,737 (2)
Dr Belanja faedah 4,974; Dr Liabiliti pajakan 15,026; Cr Bank 20,000 (2)
Dr Belanja susut nilai 16,579; Cr Susut nilai terkumpul 16,579 (1)

q.en: Explain how a lessor accounts for a finance lease and an operating lease.
q.ms: Terangkan bagaimana lessor mengakaunkan pajakan kewangan dan pajakan operasi.

en: Finance lease: derecognise asset; recognise lease receivable = net investment (2)
Receipts = principal receipt + finance income at a constant periodic rate (1)
Operating lease: keep the asset and depreciate it (1)
Expense costs of earning income, e.g. depreciation (1)
Lease income straight-line over the lease term (1)
ms: Pajakan kewangan: nyahiktiraf aset; iktiraf belum terima pajakan = pelaburan bersih (2)
Penerimaan = penerimaan prinsipal + pendapatan kewangan pada kadar berkala tetap (1)
Pajakan operasi: kekalkan aset dan susutnilaikannya (1)
Belanjakan kos memperoleh pendapatan cth susut nilai (1)
Pendapatan pajakan garis lurus sepanjang tempoh pajakan (1)

q.en: An asset (carrying amount RM800,000, fair value RM1,000,000) is sold for RM1,000,000 and leased back for 5 years. The sale meets MFRS 15. The PV of the lease payments is RM300,000. Account for the transaction by the seller-lessee.
q.ms: Aset (amaun dibawa RM800,000, nilai saksama RM1,000,000) dijual RM1,000,000 dan dipajak balik 5 tahun. Jualan memenuhi MFRS 15. PV bayaran pajakan RM300,000. Akaunkan transaksi oleh penjual-lessee.

en: Transfer is a sale under MFRS 15, so derecognise the asset (1)
Total gain = 200,000; gain on rights transferred = 200,000 × 70% = 140,000 (2)
Dr Bank 1,000,000; Dr ROU asset 240,000 (1)
Cr Asset 800,000; Cr Lease liability 300,000; Cr Gain 140,000 (1)
Remaining 60,000 gain is not recognised (relates to the right of use retained) (1)
ms: Pemindahan ialah jualan di bawah MFRS 15, jadi nyahiktiraf aset (1)
Jumlah untung = 200,000; untung atas hak dipindahkan = 200,000 × 70% = 140,000 (2)
Dr Bank 1,000,000; Dr Aset ROU 240,000 (1)
Cr Aset 800,000; Cr Liabiliti pajakan 300,000; Cr Untung 140,000 (1)
Baki untung 60,000 tidak diiktiraf (berkaitan hak guna dikekalkan) (1)

q.en: Discuss how MFRS 16 changes lease accounting for lessees and the issues it addresses.
q.ms: Bincangkan bagaimana MFRS 16 mengubah perakaunan pajakan untuk lessee dan isu yang ditanganinya.

en: Addresses off-balance-sheet financing (1)
Single lessee model based on right-of-use (2)
Lessee recognises ROU asset and lease liability except short-term and low-value leases (2)
P/L: depreciation and interest instead of rent; assets, liabilities and EBITDA rise (1)
Must distinguish lease from service contract; subleases; SLB must meet MFRS 15 (1)
ms: Menangani pembiayaan luar kunci kira-kira (1)
Model lessee tunggal berasaskan hak guna (2)
Lessee iktiraf aset ROU dan liabiliti pajakan kecuali pajakan jangka pendek dan bernilai rendah (2)
P/L: susut nilai dan faedah menggantikan sewa; aset, liabiliti dan EBITDA naik (1)
Mesti bezakan pajakan daripada kontrak perkhidmatan; sub-pajakan; SLB mesti memenuhi MFRS 15 (1)

q.en: Is there an identified asset (and the supplier has no substantive right to substitute it)?
q.ms: Adakah ada aset dikenal pasti (dan pembekal tiada hak penggantian substantif)?

q.en: Does the customer obtain substantially all the economic benefits from using the asset?
q.ms: Adakah pelanggan memperoleh hampir semua manfaat ekonomi daripada penggunaan aset?

q.en: Does the customer direct how and for what purpose the asset is used?
q.ms: Adakah pelanggan mengarahkan bagaimana dan untuk tujuan apa aset digunakan?

t.en: It is (or contains) a lease: apply MFRS 16
t.ms: Ia ialah (atau mengandungi) pajakan: guna MFRS 16

d.en: Lessee: ROU asset and lease liability (unless exempt). Lessor: classify finance/operating.
d.ms: Lessee: aset ROU dan liabiliti pajakan (kecuali dikecualikan). Lessor: kelaskan kewangan/operasi.

t.en: Not a lease: likely a service contract

q.en: Is the lease term 12 months or less (with no purchase option)?
q.ms: Adakah tempoh pajakan 12 bulan atau kurang (tanpa opsyen belian)?

q.en: Is the underlying asset of low value (e.g. a tablet or small office equipment)?
q.ms: Adakah aset asas bernilai rendah (cth tablet atau peralatan pejabat kecil)?

t.en: Recognise a right-of-use asset and a lease liability
t.ms: Iktiraf aset hak guna dan liabiliti pajakan

d.en: Depreciate the ROU asset; unwind interest on the liability.
d.ms: Susutnilaikan aset ROU; iktiraf faedah atas liabiliti.

d.en: Recognise lease payments as an expense over the lease term.
d.ms: Iktiraf bayaran pajakan sebagai belanja sepanjang tempoh pajakan.

q.en: Does ownership transfer to the lessee by the end of the lease term?
q.ms: Adakah pemilikan berpindah kepada lessee menjelang akhir tempoh pajakan?

q.en: Is a purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised?
q.ms: Adakah opsyen belian hampir pasti dilaksanakan?

q.en: Does the lease term cover a major part of the asset's economic life?
q.ms: Adakah tempoh pajakan meliputi sebahagian besar hayat ekonomi aset?

q.en: Is the PV of lease payments substantially all of the asset's fair value?
q.ms: Adakah PV bayaran pajakan hampir keseluruhan nilai saksama aset?

q.en: Is the asset so specialised that only the lessee can use it without major modification?
q.ms: Adakah aset begitu khusus hingga hanya lessee boleh guna tanpa ubah suai besar?

t.en: Finance lease (substantially all risks and rewards transfer)
t.ms: Pajakan kewangan (hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran berpindah)

d.en: Lessor: derecognise the asset, recognise a lease receivable.
d.ms: Lessor: nyahiktiraf aset, iktiraf belum terima pajakan.

d.en: Lessor keeps the asset and recognises straight-line rental income.
d.ms: Lessor kekalkan aset dan iktiraf pendapatan sewa garis lurus.
